**Description:**
1. **Static data-store egress CIDRs matched no allocated endpoint (`F-11`, `F-15`, remediated in `PR-1` `#681`):** `c58b0913:infra/targets/gcp-gke/variables.tf` (`lines 1126–1142`) defined static CIDR variables (`memorystore_governance_psc_cidr`, `memorystore_app_psc_cidr`, `cloud_sql_cidr`) consumed by `infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf) that matched no live Memorystore PSC or Cloud SQL Private Service Access IP; connectivity worked only because `default_deny_external_egress` in `network_policy.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf) masked them with a broad `10.0.0.0/8` rule (`POAM-2026-195`). Meanwhile `c58b0913:infra/modules/memorystore_valkey/outputs.tf` indexed `endpoints[0].connections[0]` by position instead of selecting `connection_type == "CONNECTION_TYPE_PRIMARY"` (`F-14`), and `local.network_policy_spec_hash` omitted `cloud_sql_cidr` (`F-15`).
2. **Copied `default`-VPC CIDRs in `staging.tfvars` (`F-10`, remediated in `PR-1` `#681`):** `c58b0913:infra/targets/gcp-gke/staging.tfvars` (`lines 225–227`) set `memorystore_governance_psc_cidr = "10.128.0.0/20"`, `memorystore_app_psc_cidr = "10.128.0.0/20"`, and `cloud_sql_cidr = "10.6.80.0/20"`, duplicating the `default` VPC's `us-central1` subnet and out-of-band PSA ranges (`POAM-2026-173` Finding C).
3. **Missing Memorystore PSC service connection policy (`EF7c`, remediated in `PR-2` / `CP-6`):** `c58b0913:infra/modules/vpc_network/main.tf` allocated only the Cloud SQL Private Service Access (`google_compute_global_address.private_ip_alloc`) range without provisioning `google_network_connectivity_service_connection_policy.memorystore` (`service_class = "gcp-memorystore"`). Note on scope: [`infra/modules/vpc_network/main.tf`](../infra/modules/vpc_network/main.tf) already configures `INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA` firewall logging and Cloud NAT `filter = "ALL"` when `enable_audit_logging = true`, and per-workload Kubernetes pod-to-datastore isolation (`5432` / `6379`) is tracked under `POAM-2026-195` (`PR-7b`).

**Remediation (`PR-1` `#681` + `PR-2` IaC complete; live `W` verification pending):**
1. **`PR-1` (`#681`, `1f8641f6`, `DE-1` in [`BREAKING_CHANGES.md`](BREAKING_CHANGES.md)):** Deleted `memorystore_governance_psc_cidr`, `memorystore_app_psc_cidr`, and `cloud_sql_cidr` from [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/variables.tf`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/variables.tf) and [`staging.tfvars`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/staging.tfvars); filtered `primary_endpoint_ip` and `primary_endpoint_port` on `connection_type == "CONNECTION_TYPE_PRIMARY"` in [`infra/modules/memorystore_valkey/outputs.tf`](../infra/modules/memorystore_valkey/outputs.tf) ([`governance_persistence.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/governance_persistence.tftest.hcl)); derived `/32` endpoint locals (`local.governance_valkey_cidr`, `local.app_valkey_cidr`, `local.cloud_sql_cidr`) in `infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf), included `local.cloud_sql_cidr` in `local.network_policy_spec_hash`, and separated namespace-wide data-store allow rules into `the monolithic datastore egress policy`](49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf) ([`w6.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/w6.tftest.hcl), [`test_evidence_custody_wiring.py`](../tests/infrastructure/test_evidence_custody_wiring.py)).
2. **`PR-2` (`POAM-2026-173` / `CP-6` in [`BREAKING_CHANGES.md`](BREAKING_CHANGES.md)):** Provisioned `google_network_connectivity_service_connection_policy.memorystore` (`service_class = "gcp-memorystore"`) in [`infra/modules/vpc_network/main.tf`](../infra/modules/vpc_network/main.tf) and bound GKE, Linkerd webhook firewall, Cloud SQL, and both Memorystore Valkey instances to `module.vpc_network` ([`vpc_binding.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/vpc_binding.tftest.hcl), [`test_memorystore_topology.py`](../tests/infrastructure/test_memorystore_topology.py)).

**Closure Criteria:**
1. `PR-1` and `PR-2` merge with `terraform test` and infrastructure unit tests pinning `CONNECTION_TYPE_PRIMARY` output selection, dynamic `/32` endpoint CIDRs, custom-VPC binding, and the Memorystore service connection policy.
2. Clean-walk deployment (`W`, `§W`) verifies Memorystore PSC attachment, `/32` NetworkPolicy egress, and active VPC firewall & Cloud NAT log entries in Cloud Logging (`R-5`, `F-87`).

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):** Verified live in certified Gate W (`fa772122`, [`compliance/gate_w_certification.json`](../compliance/gate_w_certification.json)): Memorystore PSC attachment, `/32` `NetworkPolicy` egress, and active `compute.googleapis.com/firewall`, `compute.googleapis.com/nat_flows`, and Dataplane V2 `logs/policy-action` logs confirmed; guarded by [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/vpc_binding.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/vpc_binding.tftest.hcl) and [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/namespace_segmentation.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/namespace_segmentation.tftest.hcl).

### POAM-2026-191: Governed Advisor Uninstantiated on Staging, Direct `vllm-service` Bypass, and Missing CPU Stub E2E Conformance (`F-29`–`F-36`, `F-103`, `R-16`)

**Control:** NIST CA-7 (Continuous Monitoring), SA-11 (Developer Testing and Evaluation), SC-7 (Boundary Protection), SI-10 (Information Input Validation)
**Risk Level:** Moderate
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-12) — merged in `#698` (`13f17ad5`), `#705` (`e93894f5`), and `#709` (`80a933c1`), verified in certified Gate W (`fa772122`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-05
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
1. **Governed advisor uninstantiated under `staging.tfvars` (`F-29`–`F-32`):** [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/staging.tfvars`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/staging.tfvars) sets `inference_backend = "none"` (to avoid GPU node pools on ephemeral staging clusters), which disables `module.governed_advisor` (`count = 0` in `infra/targets/gcp-gke/main.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/main.tf)), so no governed advisor pod runs on staging and end-to-end advisor → gateway tool-execution governance (`ALLOW`, `DENY`, `DEFER`, `POST_HITL`) is untested on live clusters.
2. **Direct advisor → `vllm-service:8000` model routing and missing inference ingress `NetworkPolicy` (`EA-1`, `F-33`–`F-36`):** `infra/targets/gcp-gke/main.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/main.tf) configures `module.governed_advisor` to send chat-completion calls directly to `http://vllm-service.governance-stack.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1` instead of routing through the gateway's OpenAI-compatible inference proxy (`POST /v1/chat/completions` in [`src/gateway/server/inference_proxy.py`](../src/gateway/server/inference_proxy.py)), and `infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf) lacks an ingress `NetworkPolicy` restricting TCP `8000` on inference pods exclusively to `app = gateway`.
3. **No CPU-only `inference_backend = "stub"` for deterministic E2E staging conformance (`F-103`, `R-16`):** No deterministic OpenAI-compatible CPU stub server exists to exercise the full `governed-advisor` → `gateway` (`POST /v1/chat/completions` + `/tools/execute`) → `DeferQueue` loop on staging without GPUs while keeping LLM semantic rails (`CAGE_CONSENSUS_CRITICS_ENABLED`, `CAGE_NEMO_ENABLED`) disabled and refusing `inference_backend = "stub"` in `environment == "prod"`.

**Remediation Plan (`PR-6`):**
1. Add a deterministic OpenAI-compatible CPU stub backend (`inference_backend = "stub"`, refused in `prod` via a `lifecycle` `precondition`), re-route `module.governed_advisor` model traffic through `http://gateway-service.<ns>.svc.cluster.local:8080/v1`, add an ingress `NetworkPolicy` restricting TCP `8000` on inference pods to `app = gateway`, and add an E2E advisor proxy conformance suite exercising `ALLOW`, `DENY`, `DEFER`, and `POST_HITL` without GPUs (`R-16`).

**Closure Criteria:**
1. `PR-6` merges with `terraform test` (verifying `inference_backend = "stub"` works in `staging` and fails plan in `prod`), ingress `NetworkPolicy` isolation on TCP `8000`, and green E2E advisor proxy conformance tests (`ALLOW`/`DENY`/`DEFER`/`POST_HITL`).
2. Clean-walk deployment (`W`) runs the E2E advisor proxy conformance suite against the live staging cluster.

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):** Verified live in certified Gate W (`fa772122`, [`compliance/gate_w_certification.json`](../compliance/gate_w_certification.json)): E2E advisor proxy conformance suite passed (`12 passed, 0 failed`); guarded by [`tests/unit/test_inference_stub_and_proxy.py`](../tests/unit/test_inference_stub_and_proxy.py) and [`tests/integration/test_advisor_proxy_e2e_invariants.py`](../tests/integration/test_advisor_proxy_e2e_invariants.py).

### POAM-2026-192: Orphaned `agentsight` and `cage-eval-worker` Workloads and Pending ClickHouse Pod on Live `cage-staging` (`F-47`, `F-48`)

**Control:** NIST CM-2 (Baseline Configuration), CM-6 (Configuration Settings)
**Risk Level:** Low
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-12) — verified in certified Gate W (`fa772122`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-05
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
1. **Workloads running on `cage-staging` outside `infra/targets/gcp-gke` Terraform state (`F-47`):** Comparing `kubectl get deployments,daemonsets,statefulsets -A` on `cage-staging` against `default.tfstate` (`serial: 695`) identified workloads running in `governance-stack` outside `infra/targets/gcp-gke`: the `agentsight` DaemonSet (`de5534ac:deployment/k8s/agentsight-daemon.yaml`), `cage-eval-worker`, and `reconciliation-worker` (`#664` `372daad2` subsequently added [`infra/modules/reconciliation_worker`](../infra/modules/reconciliation_worker/main.tf) to Terraform on `2026-11-06`).
2. **Unschedulable ClickHouse pod on `cage-staging` (`F-48`):** `chi-cage-clickhouse-cage-0-0-0` sits in `Pending` (`0/1`) on `cage-staging` (`default.tfstate` `serial: 695`) because `clickhouse_node_count = 0` in [`staging.tfvars`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/staging.tfvars), while `agentsight-ui` is configured with `CLICKHOUSE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8123"` (`F-49`). Note: ClickHouse is retained as Langfuse v3's OLAP backend (`#663` `24a10b14` isolated the `default` superuser and scoped `langfuse_app` to `langfuse.*`, and `#667` `4c48d107` retired the uninstantiated `4c48d107^:src/compliance_bridge/clickhouse_sink.py` governance sink).

**Remediation Plan:**
1. Retire AgentSight under `§11a` (`R-3`, `POAM-2026-193`), size/schedule Langfuse's ClickHouse backend cleanly for staging, and replace the cluster from clean Terraform state during `W` (`§W`), recording the removal of the unmanaged `agentsight` and `cage-eval-worker` workloads as intended disposal.

**Closure Criteria:**
1. Clean-walk deployment (`W`, `§W`) shows zero workloads in `governance-stack` outside `default.tfstate` and zero `Pending` workload pods after Stage 2 apply.

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):** Certified Gate W (`fa772122`, [`compliance/gate_w_certification.json`](../compliance/gate_w_certification.json), `readiness-pods.json`) verified zero out-of-state workloads in `governance-stack` and zero `Pending` workload pods (`chi-cage-clickhouse-cage-0-0-0` and all Deployments `1/1 Running`, `0` restarts); guarded by [`tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py`](../tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py).

### POAM-2026-193: Dormant AgentSight Infrastructure Carrying Privileged DaemonSet, Unauthenticated LoadBalancer, WORM Bucket IAM Access, and Unchained `/v1/infra/events` (`F-49`, `F-69`–`F-76`, `F-79`, `F-85`)

**Control:** NIST AC-6 (Least Privilege), CM-7 (Least Functionality), IA-3 (Device Identification and Authentication), SC-7 (Boundary Protection), SI-4 (System Monitoring), AU-9 (Protection of Audit Information)
**Risk Level:** Moderate
**Status:** Open — verified across [`src/agentsight-ui/`](../src/agentsight-ui/Dockerfile), `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/agentsight-daemon.yaml`, [`infra/modules/agentsight_ui/`](../infra/modules/agentsight_ui/main.tf), [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/iam.tf`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/iam.tf), and [`src/compliance_bridge/main.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/main.py) on `2026-11-05` (`POAM-2026-194` was folded into `POAM-2026-167` Closure Criterion 4; ClickHouse RBAC isolation merged in `#663` `24a10b14` and `ClickHouseSink` retirement merged in `#667` `4c48d107`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-05
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
1. **Zero active `agentsight_*` producers (`AS-0`, `F-68`):** As recorded in reopened `POAM-021` ([`POAM_US_FED.md`](compliance/us_fed/POAM_US_FED.md)), nothing in `src/` or `deployment/` emits `agentsight_*` eBPF events, and the unmanaged `agentsight` DaemonSet has been refused by Binary Authorization on `cage-staging` since `2026-09-06` (Cloud Audit Logs).
2. **Privileged DaemonSet and host namespace sharing (`F-69`, `F-70`):** `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/agentsight-daemon.yaml` requests `privileged: true`, `hostPID: true`, `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`, `CAP_BPF`, and mounts `/sys/kernel/debug` and `/sys/fs/bpf` while pinned to a placeholder image digest (`sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`, the SHA-256 of the empty string).
3. **Unauthenticated external `LoadBalancer` UI (`F-71`–`F-75`, `F-49`):** [`infra/modules/agentsight_ui/main.tf`](../infra/modules/agentsight_ui/main.tf) exposes `agentsight-ui` via an internet-facing `LoadBalancer` Service on plain HTTP port `8080` with `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` unreferenced by the container and `CLICKHOUSE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8123"` in [`staging.tfvars`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/staging.tfvars). (ClickHouse's built-in `default` superuser exposure was remediated separately in `#663` `24a10b14`, scoping `langfuse_app` strictly to `langfuse.*`, and `#667` `4c48d107` retired `4c48d107^:src/compliance_bridge/clickhouse_sink.py`; ClickHouse itself remains in `infra/modules/clickhouse_operator/` as Langfuse v3's OLAP store.)
4. **Unnecessary WORM bucket IAM binding and stdout-only `/v1/infra/events` (`F-85`):** [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/iam.tf`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/iam.tf) grants `google_service_account.agentsight` (`cage-agentsight-ui`) `roles/storage.objectViewer` on `module.worm_bucket` even though [`src/agentsight-ui/`](../src/agentsight-ui/Dockerfile) never reads from GCS, and `POST /v1/infra/events` in [`src/compliance_bridge/main.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/main.py) logs caller-supplied infrastructure events only to container stdout after `#667` without writing KMS-signed WORM batches via `EvidenceCustodian`.

**Remediation Plan (`§11a` / `R-3`, `AS-1`–`AS-5`, `D-AS-9` / `R-9`):**
1. Retire AgentSight cleanly under the Reference Architecture principle (*Clean Architecture Over Operational Continuity*): delete `src/agentsight-ui/`, `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/agentsight-daemon.yaml`, `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/cilium/README.md` (`cilium-l7-audit-policy.yaml`), and [`infra/modules/agentsight_ui/`](../infra/modules/agentsight_ui/main.tf); remove `module.agentsight_ui` and `google_service_account.agentsight` (including its WORM bucket IAM binding) from `infra/targets/gcp-gke/`; migrate Prometheus evidence-pipeline metrics to the compliance bridge (`D-AS-9`, `R-9`); and either batch `/v1/infra/events` into `EvidenceCustodian` WORM storage or retire unverified event claims in `PR-7c`.

**Closure Criteria:**
1. All AgentSight UI/DaemonSet modules, manifests, and `google_service_account.agentsight` bindings are removed (`§11a` / `R-3`), `/v1/infra/events` WORM custody or OSCAL claim retirement is complete, `terraform test` and Gate G9 pass, and the merge commit SHA is recorded here.

### POAM-2026-195: Unapplied Static Network/Mesh Policies, Shared Data-Store Egress in `network_policy.tf`, and Missing OPA/NeMo `securityContext` (`F-16`–`F-20`, `F-102`)

**Control:** NIST SC-7 (Boundary Protection), AC-3 (Access Enforcement), AC-4 (Information Flow Enforcement), CM-7 (Least Functionality)
**Risk Level:** Moderate
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-13) — merged across `#686` (`93a5e31d`), `#697` (`41f9f945`), `#699` (`dd272b23`), `#724` (`e1421593`), and `#733` (`88015ad8`), verified in certified Gate W (`8956f505`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-05
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
1. **Static manifests under `deployment/k8s/` are never applied by Terraform (`F-16`, `F-18`, `F-20`):** `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/network-policy.yaml`, `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/network-policy-hardening.yaml`, `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/linkerd-mtls-policy.yaml`, and `de5534ac:deployment/k8s/cilium/egress-lockdown.yaml` are cited as `implemented` evidence in OSCAL `SC-7`/`AC-3`/`AC-4` (`POAM-2026-169` instance 2) but no Terraform resource applies them.
2. **Inline `network_policy.tf` omits ingress isolation and shares data-store egress across all pods (`F-16`, `F-18`):** `infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf) defines egress-only `NetworkPolicy` resources (except for `reconciler_isolation`), and `default_deny_external_egress` permits **every** pod in `governance-stack` to egress to `10.0.0.0/8` on TCP `5432` (Cloud SQL), `6379` (both governance and app Memorystore Valkey instances), `8080`, `8000`, and `8181`, so the untrusted advisor pod (`governed-advisor`) can connect directly to Cloud SQL (`5432`) and governance Valkey (`6379`) at the network layer.
3. **Linkerd `defaultInboundPolicy = "all-unauthenticated"`, missing OPA/NeMo/bridge `Server` & `AuthorizationPolicy` resources (`F-17`, `F-19`), and two-service `:9090` inbound mTLS bypass:** [`infra/modules/service_mesh/main.tf`](../infra/modules/service_mesh/main.tf) sets `defaultInboundPolicy = "all-unauthenticated"`, `mesh_policy_enabled` defaults to `false` in [`infra/modules/gateway/variables.tf`](../infra/modules/gateway/variables.tf), no Terraform resource creates Linkerd `Server` / `AuthorizationPolicy` objects for `opa` or `nemo-guardrails`, and `config.linkerd.io/skip-inbound-ports = "9090"` bypasses Linkerd inbound mTLS on two services — `gateway` ([`infra/modules/gateway/main.tf`](../infra/modules/gateway/main.tf), `PodMonitoring/gateway-metrics`) and `compliance-bridge` ([`infra/modules/compliance_bridge/main.tf`](../infra/modules/compliance_bridge/main.tf), `PodMonitoring/compliance-bridge-metrics`) — for unmeshed Google Managed Prometheus scraping (scoped at L3/L4 to `gmp-system` and `kube-system` on TCP `9090`/`4191` by `gateway_ingress` and `compliance_bridge_ingress` in [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf)).
4. **Missing pod and container `securityContext` on `opa` and `nemo-guardrails` (`F-102`):** Both `opa` deployments ([`infra/modules/opa_policy/main.tf`](../infra/modules/opa_policy/main.tf) and the gateway's `opa` deployment in [`infra/modules/gateway/main.tf`](../infra/modules/gateway/main.tf)) and `nemo-guardrails` ([`infra/modules/nemo_guardrails/main.tf`](../infra/modules/nemo_guardrails/main.tf)) omit pod and container `security_context` blocks (`run_as_non_root = true`, `read_only_root_filesystem = true`, `allow_privilege_escalation = false`, `capabilities { drop = ["ALL"] }`, `seccomp_profile { type = "RuntimeDefault" }`), and `module.opa` creates a duplicate `opa` Deployment/Service in `governance-stack` alongside `module.gateway`'s `opa` (`§10b` / `R-15`).

**Remediation Plan (`PR-7a`, `PR-7b`, `§10b` / `R-15`):**
1. **`PR-7a` & `§10b` (`R-15`):** Deduplicate `module.opa` vs. `module.gateway`'s `opa` (`§10b`), add hardened pod and container `security_context` blocks to `opa` and `nemo-guardrails` (`F-102`), enable `mesh_policy_enabled = true` by default in enforcing postures (`F-17`), set `defaultInboundPolicy = "all-authenticated"`, and materialize Linkerd `Server` and `AuthorizationPolicy` resources for `gateway`, `compliance-bridge`, `opa`, and `nemo-guardrails` in Terraform (`F-19`).
2. **`PR-7b`:** Replace the shared `10.0.0.0/8` data-store egress rule in `infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/network_policy.tf) with default-deny ingress + per-workload ingress/egress `NetworkPolicy` rules restricting Cloud SQL (`5432`) egress to `langfuse` and `compliance-bridge` and governance Valkey (`6379`) egress to `gateway`, `compliance-bridge`, and `reconciliation-worker`, and delete the unapplied static `deployment/k8s/network-policy*.yaml` and `linkerd-mtls-policy.yaml` manifests (`F-16`, `F-18`, `F-20`).

**Closure Criteria:**
1. `PR-7a`, `PR-7b`, and `§10b` (`R-15`) merge with `terraform test` and pytest guards verifying per-workload ingress/egress `NetworkPolicy` isolation, Linkerd `Server`/`AuthorizationPolicy` coverage, and hardened `security_context` blocks across all governance workloads.

**Closure Verification (2026-11-13):** Merged across `#686` (`93a5e31d`, retirement of shadow `93a5e31d^:deployment/k8s/` manifests), `#697` (`41f9f945`, OPA deduplication into hardened UDS sidecar), `#699` (`dd272b23`, standalone GKE NeMo retirement, default-deny ingress + per-workload `/32` `NetworkPolicy` segmentation across Cloud SQL `5432` and Memorystore Valkey instances on port `6379`, and Linkerd `Server`/`AuthorizationPolicy` coverage), `#724` (`e1421593`, native `initContainers` OPA sidecar), and `#733` (`88015ad8`, cluster-wide `defaultInboundPolicy = "all-authenticated"` and meshed `:9090`/`4191` operational telemetry scrape policies removing `config.linkerd.io/skip-inbound-ports = "9090"`). Verified live in certified clean-room Gate W (`8956f505`, [`compliance/gate_w_certification.json`](../compliance/gate_w_certification.json): [`compliance/lula/lula-validation-ia3.yaml`](../compliance/lula/lula-validation-ia3.yaml) and [`compliance/lula/lula-validation-ac3.yaml`](../compliance/lula/lula-validation-ac3.yaml) `satisfied`, ~~[`compliance/lula/lula-validation-sc8.yaml`](../compliance/lula/lula-validation-sc8.yaml) `satisfied`,~~ plus Dataplane V2 `logs/policy-action` verified), and guarded by [`infra/modules/service_mesh/tests/mesh_proxy_required.tftest.hcl`](../infra/modules/service_mesh/tests/mesh_proxy_required.tftest.hcl), [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/namespace_segmentation.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/namespace_segmentation.tftest.hcl), and [`tests/test_gateway_mesh_policy.py`](../tests/test_gateway_mesh_policy.py).

**Correction (2026-11-14, POAM-2026-219):** `lula-validation-sc8.yaml` is withdrawn from this closure's evidence. Since `#664` (`372daad2`) its only check is `redis_ca_pinned`, Memorystore CA pinning (POAM-2026-086); the default-deny NetworkPolicy check it once made is gone, so its `satisfied` result says nothing about NetworkPolicy isolation. The closure stands on the `ia3` and `ac3` results, the Dataplane V2 policy-action logs, and the three guards above.

### POAM-2026-196: Dual-Control Escalation Workload-SVID / Empty-Allowlist Bypass, Unset `initiator_urn`, Optional WebAuthn Binding, and Shared Langfuse Secrets (`F-40`–`F-46`, `F-84`, `R-2`)

**Control:** NIST AC-3 (Access Enforcement), AC-5 (Separation of Duties), IA-2 (Identification and Authentication), AU-9 (Protection of Audit Information)
**Risk Level:** Moderate
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-12) — merged in `#689` (`7d90c20f`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-05
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
Four defects weaken dual-control HITL escalation and telemetry-credential separation:
1. **Workload SVID acceptance, empty-allowlist bypass, and `agw_adapter` OIDC delegation in `require_operator_identity()` (`F-40`–`F-44`):** On `POST /v1/defer/{defer_id}/escalate` ([`src/compliance_bridge/main.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/main.py) `line 2762`), `require_operator_identity()` in [`src/compliance_bridge/auth.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/auth.py) (`lines 180–305`) accepts Linkerd workload SVIDs (`l5d-client-id`) as human operator identities (`spiffe://...`), skips the operator allowlist check whenever `CAGE_TRUSTED_OPERATOR_IDENTITIES` is unset (`_trusted_operator_identities()` returns an empty `frozenset()` at `lines 93–96`, and `lines 251–252, 299–300` guard the check behind `if trusted and ...`), and delegated OIDC bearer-token validation (`CAGE_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_ALLOW_OIDC=true`) to `385e502e:src/gateway/governance/ingress/agw_adapter.py` (`385e502e:src/compliance_bridge/auth.py`, replaced in `AR-1` / `POAM-2026-189` by [`src/compliance_bridge/oidc_verifier.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/oidc_verifier.py)).
2. **`initiator_urn` left unset at park time (`F-41`, `AC-5`):** `_park_defer_context()` in [`src/gateway/governance/governor/verdicts.py`](../src/gateway/governance/governor/verdicts.py) (`lines 329–345`) never populates `initiator_urn` on the parked `DeferToken`, neutralizing self-approval rejection (`operator_urn == token.initiator_urn`) inside `DeferQueue.approve()`.
3. **Optional WebAuthn challenge binding (`F-45`, `POAM-2026-169` Instance 13):** `ApprovalRecord` and `DeferQueue.approve()` in [`src/gateway/governance/defer_queue.py`](../src/gateway/governance/defer_queue.py) (`lines 271–335`) leave `client_data_json` and `challenge_binding` optional (`str | None = None`), and `defer_escalate()` in [`src/compliance_bridge/main.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/main.py) (`lines 3074–3078`) accepts and forwards neither field while [`docs/architecture/DEFERRAL_QUEUE.md`](architecture/DEFERRAL_QUEUE.md) previously claimed WebAuthn binding was mandatory.
4. **Shared `advisor-secrets` Langfuse telemetry credentials across `gateway` and `governed-advisor` (`F-84`, `R-2`):** [`infra/modules/gateway/main.tf`](../infra/modules/gateway/main.tf) mounts `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` and `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY` from `advisor-secrets`, sharing Langfuse telemetry credentials (operational telemetry, not audit custody) with the untrusted `governed-advisor` pod so advisor compromise can forge gateway-attributed Langfuse traces/scores.

**Remediation Plan (`PR-5`):**
1. Require a non-empty `CAGE_TRUSTED_OPERATOR_IDENTITIES` allowlist in enforcing postures, authenticate human operators via an in-house OIDC JWT/JWKS verifier on `escalate` (decoupled from `agw_adapter.py` and rejecting workload SVIDs unless explicitly configured for dev/test), populate `initiator_urn` from the verified caller identity in `_park_defer_context()`, require `client_data_json` and `challenge_binding` on `POST /v1/defer/{defer_id}/escalate` in enforcing postures, and provision a dedicated `gateway-secrets` Kubernetes Secret so `gateway` and `governed-advisor` never share Langfuse telemetry credentials (`F-84`, `R-2`).

**Closure Criteria:**
1. `PR-5` merges with unit and integration tests covering fail-closed empty `CAGE_TRUSTED_OPERATOR_IDENTITIES`, in-house OIDC operator verification, `initiator_urn` self-approval rejection, mandatory WebAuthn binding in enforcing postures, and separate `gateway-secrets` vs. `advisor-secrets` credentials, and the merge commit SHA is recorded here.

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):** Merged on `main` in `#689` (`7d90c20f`); guarded by [`tests/unit/governance/test_hitl_operator_identity.py`](../tests/unit/governance/test_hitl_operator_identity.py) and [`tests/test_compliance_bridge_integration.py`](../tests/test_compliance_bridge_integration.py).

### POAM-2026-197: Ephemeral Workload-Project WORM/CMEK Coupling Across Rebuilds, Unarchived Public-Key Manifests, and Disabled KMS `DATA_READ` Audit Logs (`F-94`, `F-96`, `F-97`, `R-10`)

**Control:** NIST AU-9 (Protection of Audit Information), AU-11 (Audit Record Retention), AU-12 (Audit Record Generation), SC-12 (Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management), SC-28 (Protection of Information at Rest)
**Risk Level:** Moderate
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-12) — merged in `#700` (`9a86111d`), `#701` (`498a6e51`), `#702` (`1d3b1427`), `#706` (`390a582c`), and `#721` (`1ce556dc`), verified in certified Gate W (`fa772122`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-05
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
1. **WORM bucket and CMEK key live inside the ephemeral workload project (`F-94`, `F-97`):** While `module.worm_bucket` ([`infra/modules/worm_bucket/main.tf`](../infra/modules/worm_bucket/main.tf)) locks retention (`is_locked = local.enforcing_posture`: 1 day in `staging`, 2555 days in `prod`) and [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/variables.tf`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/variables.tf) defaults `kms_signing_protection_level = "HSM"`, both the WORM bucket (`gs://<PROJECT_ID>-evidence-worm-*`) and the symmetric CMEK key (`cage-cmek-<env>`) reside inside the ephemeral workload project `var.project_id`. Tearing down a staging project deletes WORM objects once the 24-hour staging lock expires, and destroying or rotating away the workload project's CMEK key cryptographically shreds archived WORM objects (`R-10`, `AS-6`).
2. **Unarchived `kid` → PEM public-key manifests and unlinked `GENESIS` records across cluster rebuilds (`F-97`):** Signing public-key manifests (`kid` → PEM) are not archived in WORM storage alongside attested evidence batches, and `EvidenceStreamSink` ([`src/gateway/governance/evidence/stream.py`](../src/gateway/governance/evidence/stream.py)) initializes a fresh `GENESIS` record after a cluster/Valkey rebuild without binding `previous_chain_head_hash` or `previous_batch_attestation_digest` from the prior WORM chain head.
3. **Missing Cloud KMS `DATA_READ` audit logging (`F-96`, `POAM-2026-169` Instance 11):** Cloud KMS `AsymmetricSign` is a GCP `DATA_READ` Data Access audit event (disabled by default in GCP), and `infra/targets/gcp-gke/` defines no `google_project_iam_audit_config` for `cloudkms.googleapis.com` and no `google_logging_project_sink` exporting KMS signing logs to retention-locked `evidence_domain` storage (`>= 2555-day` in `prod`, `POAM-2026-197`) beyond `_Default`'s 30-day retention.

**Remediation Plan (`PR-10` / `R-10`, `AS-6`):**
1. Support an external foundational audit-custody project (`audit_project_id`, `AS-6`) decoupling WORM storage and CMEK/signing key custody from ephemeral workload-cluster teardown, archive `kid` → PEM public-key manifests into WORM storage, bind post-rebuild `GENESIS` records to the prior WORM chain head when continuing an existing archive, enable `google_project_iam_audit_config` (`DATA_READ`, `ADMIN_READ`, `DATA_WRITE`) for `cloudkms.googleapis.com` with a retention-locked log sink (`F-96`), and restate OSCAL `AU-9`/`AU-11`/`AU-12`/`SC-12`/`SC-28` narratives (`R-10`).

**Closure Criteria:**
1. `PR-10` (`R-10`, `AS-6`) merges with `google_project_iam_audit_config` for `cloudkms.googleapis.com`, cross-rebuild key-manifest/chain-head continuity, updated OSCAL statements passing [`scripts/check_oscal_claim_census.py`](../scripts/check_oscal_claim_census.py), and clean-walk verification (`W`).

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):** Merged in `#700` (`9a86111d`), `#701` (`498a6e51`), `#702` (`1d3b1427`), `#706` (`390a582c`), and `#721` (`1ce556dc`), and verified live in certified Gate W (`fa772122`, [`compliance/gate_w_certification.json`](../compliance/gate_w_certification.json)): `module.evidence_domain` (`2555-day` locked in `prod` with single-project `prod` refused by `evidence_domain_isolation_guard`; `86400s` locked in `staging`, which does not close multi-year `AU-11` under `POAM-2026-084`), content-addressed PEM `trust-anchors/signing-key-manifest-<sha256>.json`, retention-locked KMS `DATA_READ`/`ADMIN_READ`/`DATA_WRITE` sinks, Stage 5b `BOUND_CHAIN_ROTATION` (`verified=7, bound_rotations=1, gaps=0`), and `AS-6` Cloud Audit Log corroboration (`PASSED`); guarded by [`tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py`](../tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py) and [`scripts/check_poam_lula_divergence.py`](../scripts/check_poam_lula_divergence.py).

### POAM-2026-198: Hardcoded Finance OPA Policy in `infra/targets/gcp-gke`, Unrefused Stub Domains in Enforcing Postures, and Unscanned Domain-Literal Scripts (`§10b`)

**Control:** NIST CM-6 (Configuration Settings), AC-3 (Access Enforcement), SA-11 (Developer Testing and Evaluation)
**Risk Level:** High
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-12) — merged in `#694` (`49c0d09a`) and `#697` (`41f9f945`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-07
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
1. **`module "opa"` hardcoded `cage_finance` Rego regardless of `var.cage_domain`:** `385e502e:infra/targets/gcp-gke/main.tf` (`lines 951–953`) mounted `file("${path.module}/../../../src/cage_finance/opa/trade_governance.rego")` into `module "opa"` unconditionally even when `var.cage_domain` was set to `"healthcare"` or `"physical_ai"` (`variables.tf` validates `contains(["finance", "healthcare", "physical_ai"], var.cage_domain)`), and `module "opa"` duplicates the `opa` sidecar/deployment inside [`infra/modules/gateway/main.tf`](../infra/modules/gateway/main.tf) (`POAM-2026-195`).
2. **Stub domains were not mechanically refused in enforcing postures:** `physical_ai` ([`src/cage_physical_ai/`](../src/cage_physical_ai/__init__.py)) is a non-production reference stub without an `opa/` policy bundle (`POAM-2026-077`), whereas `finance` ([`src/cage_finance/`](../src/cage_finance/__init__.py)) and `healthcare` ([`src/cage_healthcare/`](../src/cage_healthcare/__init__.py)) ship `maturity = "production"` plugins with OPA policy bundles (`trade.governance`, `dosing.governance`), yet neither `infra/targets/gcp-gke/` nor `assemble_governor()` (`is_enforcing()`) mechanically refused `maturity == "stub"` or empty domain Rego bundles.
3. **Operational scripts hardcoded finance/legacy policy paths outside Gate G6:** `385e502e:scripts/check_policy_drift.py` (`lines 65–67` `_DEFAULT_INPUT` / `_DEFAULT_OPA_OUT`), `385e502e:scripts/canary_opa_policy.sh` (`lines 22–24` `POLICY_FILE` / `OPA_BUNDLE_ROOT`), and `385e502e:scripts/run_matrix_tests.sh` (`line 267` `src/cage_finance/opa/`) hardcoded finance or unparameterized legacy policy paths while `385e502e:scripts/check_domain_literals.py` (`Gate G6`) did not scan `scripts/`.

**Note (2026-11-14, `DM-1`):** item 2 describes the tree when this entry was opened. `healthcare` has since declared `maturity = "stub"`, so the guard this entry added refuses it in every enforcing posture, as it does `physical_ai` (`POAM-2026-077`).

**Remediation Plan (`Wave 2.7` / `§10b` & `R-15`):**
1. Parameterize `opa_policies` in `infra/targets/gcp-gke/main.tf` (49c0d09a:infra/targets/gcp-gke/main.tf) via `fileset("${path.module}/../../../src/cage_${var.cage_domain}/opa", "*.rego")` excluding `*_test.rego` (verified in [`domain_opa_policies.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/domain_opa_policies.tftest.hcl) for `finance`, `healthcare`, and `physical_ai` refusal), test `OPAClient.verify_domain_policy()` fail-closed rejection on wrong-domain policy bundles, and deduplicate `module "opa"` vs. `module.gateway` (`R-15`).
2. Add `CagePlugin.maturity: Literal["production", "stub"]` so `assemble_governor()` refuses `"stub"` plugins whenever `is_enforcing(posture)` is true, and enforce non-empty domain `.rego` bundle preconditions on `terraform_data.domain_opa_policies_guard` (`module.opa` `depends_on`, `POAM-2026-180`) and `kubernetes_config_map.opa_policies` in [`infra/modules/opa_policy/main.tf`](../infra/modules/opa_policy/main.tf).
3. Parameterize [`scripts/check_policy_drift.py`](../scripts/check_policy_drift.py) (`--domain`), retire `385e502e:scripts/canary_opa_policy.sh` and `385e502e^:scripts/run_matrix_tests.sh` (live posture checks folded into [`scripts/staging_lifecycle.sh`](../scripts/staging_lifecycle.sh) Phases 3–5), and extend [`scripts/check_domain_literals.py`](../scripts/check_domain_literals.py) (`Gate G6`) to scan non-test operational scripts.

**Closure Criteria:**
1. `Wave 2.7` (`§10b`) and `R-15` merge with [`domain_opa_policies.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/domain_opa_policies.tftest.hcl) (positive and negative assertions), `CagePlugin.maturity` runtime refusal tests, `OPAClient.verify_domain_policy()` mismatch refusal tests, and expanded Gate G6 coverage, and the merge commit SHA is recorded here.

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):** Merged on `main` in `#694` (`49c0d09a`) and `#697` (`41f9f945`); guarded by [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/domain_opa_policies.tftest.hcl`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/tests/domain_opa_policies.tftest.hcl), [`tests/test_server_inputs.py`](../tests/test_server_inputs.py), and [`scripts/check_domain_literals.py`](../scripts/check_domain_literals.py).

### POAM-2026-200: Chained Pre-Commit Hook Wrapper Recorded Unconditional `gates=9/9` Pass Prior to `exec`ing the 29-Gate Hook (Reopened — Outer Wrapper Refusals Unrecorded)

**Control:** NIST AU-2 (Event Logging), AU-3 (Content of Audit Records), SA-11 (Developer Testing and Evaluation)
**Risk Level:** Moderate (Low until reopened: the records now missing are refusals, not passes)
**Status:** Open (Reopened `2026-11-15` — the outer wrapper's own refusals leave no record; the `2026-11-12` closure, merged in `#703` (`dfacc565`), `#705` (`e93894f5`) and `#721` (`1ce556dc`), covers the 29-gate hook only)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-09
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-30

**Description:**
When [`scripts/setup_git_hooks.sh`](../scripts/setup_git_hooks.sh) (`resolve_hook_target`) installed the full 29-gate pre-commit hook behind a chained outer wrapper (`orig="$(dirname "$0")/pre-commit.<suffix>"; exec "$orig" "$@"`), the outer wrapper appended a hardcoded `gates=9/9` pass line to the local `.git` pre-commit audit log **before** calling `exec "$orig"`, and the delegated hook itself wrote no post-execution audit record. Consequently, every recorded line reported `gates=9/9` and implied success by construction—understating actual gate coverage (`29` deterministic checks) while making it structurally impossible for the log to record a failure in `ruff`, `mypy`, or Gates `G3`–`G11` even when the commit was blocked.

**Remediation Plan:**
1. Update the `pre-commit` hook installed by [`scripts/setup_git_hooks.sh`](../scripts/setup_git_hooks.sh) to count every executed gate dynamically (`gates_passed` / `gates_total`) and write the audit record inside an `EXIT` trap **after** all gates finish (or immediately upon failure), recording real `status=pass|fail`, `exit_code=<rc>`, `gates=<passed>/<total>`, and `failed_gate=<name>`, while replacing in place any premature `gates=9/9` wrapper entry written prior to `exec` for the same `(branch, tree)`.
2. Guard with [`test_poam_2026_200_precommit_audit_log_records_fail_and_pass_after_chained_exec`](../tests/test_setup_git_hooks.py) in [`tests/test_setup_git_hooks.py`](../tests/test_setup_git_hooks.py).

**Closure Criteria:**
1. [`scripts/setup_git_hooks.sh`](../scripts/setup_git_hooks.sh) and [`tests/test_setup_git_hooks.py`](../tests/test_setup_git_hooks.py) merge to `main`, `test_poam_2026_200_precommit_audit_log_records_fail_and_pass_after_chained_exec` passes on both failing and passing commits, and the merge commit SHA is recorded here.

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):** Merged on `main` in `#703` (`dfacc565`), `#705` (`e93894f5`), and `#721` (`1ce556dc`); guarded by [`tests/test_setup_git_hooks.py`](../tests/test_setup_git_hooks.py).

**Reopened (`2026-11-15`):** The chain has two hooks, and the closure fixed the inner one. The outer wrapper, installed by local tooling outside this repository, runs the leak guard in pre-commit mode and then, inside this repository, nine deterministic gates of its own (Gates G3, G6, G7, G8 and G9, project-ID hygiene, STPA freshness, license headers and the pytest marker contract), each ending in `|| exit 1` under `set -eu`. It appends its `gates=9/9` line only after all of them pass, then `exec`s the 29-gate hook, whose `EXIT` trap writes the real result and replaces that line. A failure in the wrapper exits before either hook writes anything. On `2026-11-15` a Gate G8 refusal (a partner name in a test literal) and a Gate G9 refusal (a stale line range) each left no record, while a `ruff format` refusal by the 29-gate hook earlier that day was recorded with `failed_gate=ruff_format`. The 29-gate hook runs every gate the wrapper runs, so whether a refusal is recorded depends on which hook reached the gate first, not on what failed, and the description's "structurally impossible for the log to record a failure in ... Gates `G3`–`G11`" still holds for the gates the wrapper runs. The log records every pass and some refusals. A reader counting refusals undercounts with no sign that any are missing, which is harder to notice than a log that records only passes, and the refusals it drops are the events that would show a guard being worked around (`POAM-2026-214`).

**Remediation (reopened):**
1. The wrapper sets an `EXIT` trap before its first stage. On a non-zero exit before chaining, including a leak-guard refusal, it appends a record in the 29-gate hook's format: `status=fail`, `exit_code=<rc>`, `gates=<passed>/<total>`, `failed_gate=<stage>` and `leak_guard=pass|fail`. The pass path is unchanged: `exec` replaces the shell without running the trap, and the 29-gate hook still replaces the wrapper's pass line.
2. Verification plants one refusal per wrapper stage in a throwaway worktree, on a branch named for the verification so its records read as planted, and requires a `status=fail` record naming that stage for each.

**Closure Criteria (reopened):**
1. The wrapper fix is installed, and planted refusals of the leak guard and of each wrapper gate each leave a `status=fail` record naming the stage, verified on the closure date.
2. The wrapper lives outside this repository, so the closure verification here records each planted refusal and the record it produced, not the local log file.

### POAM-2026-201: Observer-Subject Custody Feedback Spiral in Scheduled Lula Audits Depressing ISO 42001 A.5.3 Safety Rate

**Control:** NIST CA-7 (Continuous Monitoring), AU-12 (Audit Record Generation), ISO/IEC 42001 A.5.3 (Logging and Monitoring)
**Risk Level:** Moderate
**Status:** Closed (`2026-11-22`, PRs `#855` `da4d82a5` & `#856` `905893b5`, verified live on scheduled `CronJob/lula-audit` `job.batch/lula-audit-29922840` `seq=743`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-10
**Target Closure:** 2026-12-15

**Description:**
1. **Post-`#704` observer-subject coupling in `GET /v1/metrics/A.5.3`:** PR `#704` (`600de728`) fixed [`_is_passing_evidence_record()`](../src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py) so a failing `CronJob/lula-audit` (`POST /v1/infra/events` — HTTP ingress only, not audit custody; `event_type == "lula_audit"`) is no longer scored as a passing `A.5.3` trace and no longer refreshes `A.5.3` SLA age. However, because `lula_audit` records are sealed onto `cage:evidence:infra:stream` (and flushed to `module.evidence_domain` WORM storage, `POAM-2026-197`) under `control_id = "A.5.3"`, [`get_compliance_metrics("A.5.3", window_hours=24)`](../src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py) still includes every `lula_audit` run in the 24-hour `A.5.3` denominator (`total_traces`) and counts any `lula_audit` run with `failed_count > 0` as a `blocked_traces` increment.
2. **Self-reinforcing 24-hour failure loop:** Once >= 3% of traces in the 24-hour union window are failing `lula_audit` observations (for example, during initial deployment or transient drift on an unrelated manifest), `A.5.3` `safety_rate` drops below [`compliance/lula/lula-validation-a53.yaml`](../compliance/lula/lula-validation-a53.yaml)'s `0.98` floor. Even after the underlying drift is fixed, every subsequent `CronJob/lula-audit` execution evaluates `lula-validation-a53.yaml`, observes `safety_rate < 0.98`, fails `a53`, and appends another failing `lula_audit` record—depressing `safety_rate` further (`0.0577` observed on an operated cluster on `2026-11-10`) until 24 hours of clean governed traffic dilute or age out the observer's own failure records.

**Remediation Plan:**
1. Separate observer-audit health (`event_type == "lula_audit"`, surfaced in-cluster via `cage_lula_audit_*` Prometheus gauges, `notifier.send_critical_alert()`, and the `2 × schedule` dead-man's switch in [`sla_monitor.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/sla_monitor.py)) from governed-subject `A.5.3` trace-logging `safety_rate` in [`src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py), while keeping every `lula_audit` `INFRA` record sealed in `cage:evidence:infra:stream` and `module.evidence_domain` WORM custody (`POAM-2026-197`).
2. Add a regression test in [`tests/test_compliance_bridge_metrics.py`](../tests/test_compliance_bridge_metrics.py) proving that a failing `lula_audit` event emits in-cluster alert state and refuses SLA-age refresh without poisoning subsequent `A.5.3` `safety_rate` evaluations once governed subject traffic is healthy.

**Closure Criteria:**
1. [`src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py) decouples `lula_audit` (and all control-evaluation output records) from the evaluated control's own `safety_rate` denominator/blocked counts while preserving fail-closed `A.5.3` SLA freshness and `lula_audit` in-cluster telemetry.
2. Regression tests in [`tests/test_compliance_bridge_metrics.py`](../tests/test_compliance_bridge_metrics.py) and [`tests/unit/test_compliance_self_eval_and_cache.py`](../tests/unit/test_compliance_self_eval_and_cache.py) (binding `POAM-2026-201`) verify recovery after a transient `lula_audit` failure without waiting 24 hours, the merge commit SHA is recorded here, and a scheduled `CronJob/lula-audit` run on `cage-staging` completes all `26` active manifests with `failed_count == 0` (only `a52`/`a53`/`a92` in `insufficient_traffic` or `insufficient_sample`, since `cage-staging` excludes `canary: True` probes and cannot evidence statistical rate controls) while `GET /v1/metrics/A.5.3` reports `self_evaluation_records_excluded > 0`.

**Closure Verification (`2026-11-22`):**
1. **Generalized Self-Evaluation Anti-Latch & Threshold-Derived Sample Floor (`#855` `da4d82a5`, `#856` `905893b5`):** [`_is_self_evaluation_record()`](../src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py) excludes any control-evaluation output record (`CONTROL_EVALUATION_EVENT_TYPES`: `lula_audit`, `control_assessment`, `assessment_result`, `record_role="control_evaluation"`, or explicit `evaluated_control*` targets) emitted for control `X` from `X`'s own input population, incrementing `self_evaluation_records_excluded` on [`ComplianceMetrics`](../src/compliance_bridge/types.py) while keeping every `lula_audit` receipt in `cage:evidence:infra:stream` WORM custody and retaining in-cluster `cage_lula_audit_*` gauges, `notifier.send_critical_alert()`, and [`get_last_passing_lula_audit_age_seconds()`](../src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py) / [`get_last_healthy_lula_audit_age_seconds()`](../src/compliance_bridge/metrics.py) (external Pub/Sub delivery closed `2026-11-23` under `POAM-2026-230`). Paired with [`derive_min_sample_size()`](../src/compliance_bridge/types.py) (`150` for `A.5.3` `0.98`, `300` for `A.5.2` `0.99` and zero-tolerance `A.9.2` `1.0` with immediate `n = 1` failure on `safety_rate < 1.0`, `POAM-2026-244`) across [`lula-validation-a52.yaml`](../compliance/lula/lula-validation-a52.yaml), [`lula-validation-a53.yaml`](../compliance/lula/lula-validation-a53.yaml), [`lula-validation-a92.yaml`](../compliance/lula/lula-validation-a92.yaml), [`oscal_exporter.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/oscal_exporter.py), [`oscal_parser.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/oscal_parser.py), and [`run_lula_audit.sh`](../infra/modules/lula_cron/run_lula_audit.sh). Guarded by [`tests/unit/test_compliance_self_eval_and_cache.py`](../tests/unit/test_compliance_self_eval_and_cache.py), [`tests/test_compliance_bridge_metrics.py`](../tests/test_compliance_bridge_metrics.py), [`tests/unit/test_lula_audit_alerting.py`](../tests/unit/test_lula_audit_alerting.py), and [`tests/unit/test_oscal_idle_trace_remarks.py`](../tests/unit/test_oscal_idle_trace_remarks.py).

### POAM-2026-202: Grafeas Attestor Note Deletion Cascade Wiping All Binary Authorization Image Attestations Project-Wide

**Control:** NIST SI-7 (Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity), CM-7 (Least Functionality)
**Risk Level:** High
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-12) — remediated in `#721` (`1ce556dc`) and `#722` (`72dd59d5`), verified in certified Gate W (`fa772122`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-11
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-12

**Description:**
During the first full end-to-end execution of Phase 6 (`Stage 4` `terraform destroy` → `Stage 5` `SKIP_BUILD=true` rebuild) on `2026-11-11`, `terraform destroy` deleted `google_container_analysis_note.build_attestor_note[0]` (`projects/<PROJECT_ID>/notes/cage-build-attestor-note-staging`) and `google_binary_authorization_attestor.build_attestor[0]`. In Google Cloud Container Analysis (Grafeas), deleting an `ATTESTATION_AUTHORITY` note cascade-deletes **every** signed attestation occurrence attached to that note across the entire project. When Stage 5 re-created the note and Binary Authorization policy with `SKIP_BUILD=true` (reusing the Phase 0 `@sha256:` image digests), zero image attestations remained in Grafeas, causing `imagepolicywebhook.image-policy.k8s.io` (`ENFORCED_BLOCK_AND_AUDIT_LOG`) to reject every workload pod cluster-wide. Detaching the note only inside `scripts/staging_lifecycle.sh` would have protected the Gate W harness while leaving any operator `terraform destroy` one resource deletion away from total cluster admission failure.

**Remediation Implemented in Code (`#721` `1ce556dc`, `#722` `72dd59d5`):**
1. Added `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` to both `google_container_analysis_note.build_attestor_note` and `google_binary_authorization_attestor.build_attestor` in [`infra/targets/gcp-gke/perimeter.tf`](../infra/targets/gcp-gke/perimeter.tf), making accidental Terraform destruction fail at plan time for all callers.
2. Added `google_container_analysis_note.build_attestor_note`, `google_binary_authorization_attestor.build_attestor`, and `google_service_account.cloudbuild` to `PERSISTENT_KMS_STATE_ADDRS` (`PF8` pre-destroy state detachment) and to `PF9` retained-by-design survivor verification (`post-destroy-project-inventory.json`) in [`scripts/staging_lifecycle.sh`](../scripts/staging_lifecycle.sh), matching live `gcloud` wire names (`#722` `72dd59d5`).
3. Guarded by `test_binauthz_note_and_attestor_declare_prevent_destroy` and `test_pf9_accepts_live_gcloud_wire_names_for_cloudbuild_sa_and_attestors_and_rejects_workload_sa` in [`tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py`](../tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py).

**Closure Verification (2026-11-12):**
1. Merged on `main` in `#721` (`1ce556dc`) and `#722` (`72dd59d5`).
2. Verified live in certified clean-room Gate W (`fa772122`, [`compliance/gate_w_certification.json`](../compliance/gate_w_certification.json), `2026-11-12T21:44:53Z`): Stage 4 `terraform destroy` detached `build_attestor_note` and `build_attestor`, all Phase 0 Grafeas image attestations survived, Stage 5 `SKIP_BUILD=true` rebuild admitted every pod under `ENFORCED_BLOCK_AND_AUDIT_LOG` with zero-drift Terraform plan, and Stage 6 `PF9` recorded `projects/<PROJECT_ID>/notes/cage-build-attestor-note-staging` and `cage-build-attestor-staging` under retained-by-design foundations with `0` unexpected survivors; guarded by [`tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py`](../tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py).

### POAM-2026-203: Kubelet Serial Image-Pull Startup Race Between Gateway Container and OPA UDS Sidecar

**Control:** NIST CM-6 (Configuration Settings), SC-4 (Information in Shared System Resources), SA-11 (Developer Testing and Evaluation)
**Risk Level:** Moderate
**Status:** Closed (2026-11-12) — remediated in `#724` (`e1421593`) and `#726` (`851edcd3`), verified in certified Gate W (`fa772122`)
**Date Opened:** 2026-11-12
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-12

**Description:**
During recovery validation on `2026-11-12`, `gateway` (`spec.containers[0]`) started while `opa` (`spec.containers[1]`) waited `57.8s` in kubelet's serial image-pull queue (`serializeImagePulls: true`), causing `OPAClient.verify_domain_policy()` to fail on an absent `/var/run/opa/opa.sock` with `exitCode=3` (`restartCount=1`).

**Remediation & Closure Verification (2026-11-12):**
Moved `opa` into `initContainers` with `restartPolicy = "Always"` and a `/opa check` `startupProbe` via local Helm chart [`infra/modules/gateway/deployment/templates/deployment.yaml`](../infra/modules/gateway/deployment/templates/deployment.yaml) (`#724` `e1421593`, `#726` `851edcd3`), added bounded `httpx.ConnectError`-only retry in [`src/gateway/core/policy.py`](../src/gateway/core/policy.py) while keeping immediate call-1 hard failure on bundle/rule/HTTP/timeout errors, widened cold-node readiness timeouts and recorded `drift_read_back_scope` in [`scripts/staging_lifecycle.sh`](../scripts/staging_lifecycle.sh), verified live with `0` restarts in matched-SHA clean-room and recovery Gate W (`fa772122`, [`compliance/gate_w_certification.json`](../compliance/gate_w_certification.json)), and guarded by [`tests/test_gateway_core_policy.py`](../tests/test_gateway_core_policy.py) and [`tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py`](../tests/infrastructure/test_staging_lifecycle.py).

**Control:** NIST AU-9 (Protection of Audit Information), AU-10 (Non-Repudiation), AU-12 (Audit Record Generation)
**Risk Level:** High

**Date Opened:** 2026-11-12
**Target Closure:** 2026-11-12

**Description:**
While `EvidenceStreamSink` (`cage:evidence:stream`) supported operator-supplied `EVIDENCE_PREVIOUS_CHAIN_HEAD_HASH` and `EVIDENCE_PREVIOUS_BATCH_ATTESTATION_DIGEST`, `InfraEvidenceChain` (`cage:evidence:infra:stream` in [`src/compliance_bridge/infra_custody.py`](../src/compliance_bridge/infra_custody.py)) always started at unbound genesis after ephemeral Redis teardown, causing repeated Gate W runs on a project with prior `INFRA` batches (`CronJob/lula-audit` / `Job/lula-gate-w`) to fail closed in `CustodyVerifier.verify_for_citation()` with `declared_gaps == 1`.
